grammar_rule.title: Using 'agus', 'ach', 'mar', 'cé', 'ach is', 'cé acu' in sentences
grammar_rule.explanation: Connecting words are used to link ideas or clauses in a sentence. They help to show relationships between different parts of a sentence.
examples: Tá mé ag ithe agus ól.
Bhí sé tuirseach ach lean sé ar aghaidh.
Mar tá sé fuar, tá sé ag caitheamh a sciorta.
Cé go bhfuil sé donn, tá sé geal.
Tá sé ag obair ach is maith leis é.

pronunciation_notes: Practice the pronunciation of these connecting words to improve your fluency.
Pay attention to the flow of the sentence when using these words.
Try to use these words in context to remember their meanings better.

mini_task.instruction: Create 3 sentences using the connecting words provided.
prompts: Explain a decision you made using 'mar'.
Discuss a choice you have to make using 'cé'.
